readinessDefinition: Elapsed wall time from navigation start until MapLibre status leaves 'Loading basemap' and displays the 4,213 source count.
sampleMethod: Five fresh headless Chromium contexts per viewport. Resource timing and buffered long-task entries read one second after map readiness.

fallbackReproduction.beforeFix: MARS source markers and selected-case details remained visible, but tile failure was not described.
fallbackReproduction.afterFix: An accessible non-blocking notice and Retry map button appear; selected source and coordinates remain available.
fallbackReproduction.retryOutcome: Retry reissued style/tile requests. The external imagery service continued failing for most high-zoom requests during this stress sequence, so recovery is unverified and the notice correctly remained visible.

oneOffLongAnimationFrameDiagnostic.interpretation: Separate one-off diagnostic with different network conditions; Long Animation Frame entries are not interchangeable with the cold-run Long Task API samples. It does not establish hardware performance or justify reducing visual quality.

limitations: Viewport emulation is not a physical phone or GPU benchmark.
The development server is not the deployed production/CDN route.
Resource transfer depends on the selected source zoom, browser cache, connection, and third-party tile service.
Long tasks reached 374 ms and require device-representative profiling before making responsiveness claims.
One initial manifest request was aborted and a subsequent request returned HTTP 200 in the inspected baseline request trace.
